original_kitchen_items: Begin with every item on the countertop.
Take a quick look at each one and ask three questions: - Do I use this often?
Keep only true daily or near-daily essentials out.
Keep zones basic and practical: This area should be close to your main open counter space.
Place pots, pans, cooking utensils, oven mitts, and spices near the stove.
Put these in the front of cabinets, in the top drawer, or on the most reachable shelf.
Try three routines: - Nightly reset: Put away dishes, wipe counters, return stray items to their zones, and empty the sink.
